In place of one of the dead hero was inserted another, and the born myth of the invincible Soviet soldier. The film 'Red Ghost' is about the hope that each soldier will have.
The snow will be painted red with Nazi blood.
31440: The story begins in 1917 with Stan and Ollie being drafted into the U.S. Army to fight in World War I. 31696: An earnest life-coach/author, Thomas Carter, is mysteriously abducted by a deranged client, Angel Sanchez, who delves into Thomas' teachings and uses his spiritual messages of Karma - action and reaction (Vipaka), against him to terrorize him and his family for their past sins.
Karma is Action, Vipaka is Reaction
31952: A father is on the run with his little baby girl to escape the ghosts of his past and the forces that want him dead.
32208: The innocent Célène might be falling in love with popular surfer Tristan at her new school. But she has no idea that, in actuality, she’s the object of a cruel bet between Tristan and Instagram influencer Vanessa.
32464: A man eager to serve his country but rejected by the Marines pairs up with a young runaway to form an unlikely team on a misguided adventure.

32976: When a high school party goes dangerously off the rails, one teenager finds that revenge is just a computer click away.
Youth is innocent. Youth is beautiful. Youth is dangerous.

He is a small-time crook recently released from prison and she is a prostitute craving some love and affection. They find each other in an obscure part of Gent. Jean-Claude is responsible for their meeting ; he is also an ex-inmate who has just traded the low-life crime scene for life as a pimp. Will their love survive?
33744: A close-knit family begins to come apart at the seams due to an astrologer's predictions of an imminent tragedy.

Everyone is different...some more than others

35536: A wealthy author's second wife begins to suspect that her 12-year old stepson may have murdered his mother, who mysteriously died in a bathtub accident.
What he saw is what he did.
35792: Minna, a young girl, misuses her newfound ability to create and control other people’s dreams to teach her bothersome stepsister a lesson. When her stepsister can no longer wake up, Minna has to enter the dream world to save her.
Where dreams really do come true.
36048: Since the death of their father, the Riley siblings have kept their heads above water by illegally dealing in painkillers. 36816: After losing their child, a mother finds solace in a life-sized ancient doll she finds on the market.  When a new daughter enters the family's life, strange things begin to happen and no matter how hard the family tries to get rid of it, the doll always finds its way back.
37072: An unflinching chronicle of Charles Manson, the ex-con who was able to amass a dedicated following of young people in the late 1960s. 37328: The day she turns 40, Marguerite Flora, a successful rep for a nuclear power company, begins receiving letters she'd sent to herself at age seven. 38096: Tommy and his older brother Eric live in the midst of vast remote forests. The death of their friend pushes them close to the edge. Eric doesn’t know how to channel his energy. All at once, nature’s vastness feels stifling.

What if you get 10 chances to change your past.
38608: When Battal Gazi is killed by Byzantine Prince, his son swears to take revenge.

Bullies, Pimps and Drug Dealers beware!
39376: In 1971, air-conditioner repairman and boat enthusiast Jim McCormick entertains his desire to 'go down' as a legend in the record books when the Gold Cup hydroplane boat race improbably comes to his small town of Madison, Indiana. A town's future is riding with one man.
39632: Experience an inside look at David Bowie's incredible influence on music, art and culture via interviews with some of the people who knew him best.
39888: A love triangle forms between post-Enlightenment writer Friedrich Schiller and two sisters -- one who became his wife, and the other, his biographer.
The secret story of Schiller's passion.

Who and what is waiting for the man who, for the last 25 years... hasn’t been doing anything? How will he find himself in a world where old principles and loyalty have ceased to exist? We will get to know that when fate reunites Franz and “Nowy”. Their meeting will change everything.
40400: The film chronicles George's adventures as he befriends Kayla, a baby elephant, at a magic circus show and helps her travel across the country to be reunited with her family.Accompanied by his friend, the Man with the Yellow Hat, George travels by foot, train, and truck to reach Kayla's brother and sister in California, only to be accused of elephant-napping and brought all the way back to New York.
40656: A journalist, who is still in love with his ex-girlfriend, becomes the obsession of his landlord's daughter.
40912: Follow-up to the TV trilogy “Heimat”, this time for cinemas, set again in the fictional village Schabbach in the Hunsrück region of Rhineland-Palatinate.
41168: The good guys win out in this sweet tale about a young orphan who is abused for much of her life but who eventually finds happiness when she marries an honest man who extricates her from her situation.
41424: Duke Berne, former big shot but now a three-time loser, fears returning to crime because a fourth conviction will mean a life sentence. Finally, haunted by his past and goaded by his cohorts, he joins in planning an armoured car robbery.
HUMPHREY BOGART as the Last of the Racket Barons... the Big Shot of 'em all!
41680: After his brother dies in a car crash, a disgraced MMA fighter takes over the family nightclub — and soon learns his sibling's death wasn’t an accident.
41936: A student moves into a run-down building in New York City. His bizarre neighbors make a concoction in their apartment they call wine, but when he takes some of it, he turns into a deformed, murderous monster.

Henson) and the prospect of living a normal life seems almost within reach. But will he be able to escape the crimes of his father and his past?
The hardest part about moving on is saying goodbye
42448: Set in Tenkasi, Bhavani and her family navigate unexpected challenges, after their dream venture is thwarted, comes into contact with a corpse and forced to take an adventure trip to Kodaikanal.
42704: In 2009 three young men were killed in a remote part of Yellowstone National Park. Authorities never found the murderer. He found them! The only thing more shocking than the crime itself are the bizarre events that followed.

There's a fine line between faith and madness.
44240: The story of a young mother who loses her husband in Afghanistan and struggles to raise their young daughter in his absence.
No matter where life takes you... Faith takes you further.
44496: Two female Army agents go undercover at a Nazi prison camp to get information from a scientist being held there.
A Place of Total Despair. All the youthful beauty of Europe enslaved for the pleasure of the 3rd Reich.
44752: Psychologist Dr. Brennac is asked by a colleague to help with the case of Claude, a patient on trial for multiple murders. Is Claude really guilty of the crimes, or is he a victim of his own mind?
45008: The portrait of a man and his attempts to make things up with life after losing his job.

It only takes one step to cross the point of no return.
45520: Lucie, a young dancer suffers an accident. When she wakes up from a coma, she and her partner start training for a dance show. On the way, she starts looking for her estranged father, a path that might lead her to life-changing love.

UNFAITHFUL! ...or Was She Too Lovely To Be One Man's Woman!

Facing this unprecedented calamity, will Hong Kong wake up to an overnight annihilation?

The best partners in the police station.

Malic sends his agents to kidnap Dr. Okada, a human scientist who has created a serum that can immunize exposure to radiation.
Discover the incredible world of tomorrow... 15 miles straight down at LATITUDE ZERO
Capt. Craig McKenzie / Cmdr. Glenn McKenzie

47824: A rescue unit within the Chinese Coast Guard are forced to overcome their personal differences to resolve a crisis.
48080: A judge sees his illegitimate daughter face trial for infanticide. He's certain that she will receive the death sentence.
Karl Victor von Sendlingen, court president
Franz Victor von Sendlingen, Karl's father
Franz, in service with the president
48336: A reincarnated "Satanic Witch" from New Amsterdam, circa 1600's comes back to revive her cult members by sucking the life force out of people.
48592: A good nurse ruins her career by covering up for her sister's careless mistake.
"IT TAKES A LOT TO MAKE ME LOVE A MAN In The Face Of All I Know About Them!"
48848: Trapped inside his car by a mudslide, smooth talking Jackson Alder suddenly finds himself in a situation he can't talk his way out of. With no hope of rescue, he must defy the odds; battling Mother Nature for his survival.
49104: A young man is struck and killed in a traffic accident, and the wrong man is accused of the homicide.
What is the price of hiding a truth?

Andrey travels to the ill-famed place and meets with Lavr, but before they can return to St. Petersburg they must face evil forces and creatures of the dark side.
49872: In Desert and Wilderness is a 2001 Polish film directed by Gavin Hood. Adapted from the 1911 novel In Desert and Wilderness by Henryk Sienkiewicz, it tells the story of two kids, Staś Tarkowski and Nel Rawlison, kidnapped by the rebels during Mahdi's rebellion in Sudan.

Harrad College... where free, liberated relations between coed students are encouraged!

A small-town waitress vies with a sassy city slicker for the attention of the town's most eligible bachelor.
51152: A young man struggles for justice for the victims who are affected by the chemical plant leakage which lead to many deaths in the village.

She's back in Paris, and the only person she now knows is him…

Terror From The Sky! Earth Attacked From Outer Space!

A comedy about love, loss and other felonies.
